content:
maria-finance: Heads up 5k untagged GPU charge in asia-east overnight from the "notebook-reserve" pool. Resource ids: nr-5521, nr-5522.

jay-ops: Copy. Can you share exact timestamps? I'll check autoscaler and cluster events.

maria-finance: 2026-03-22T01:12Z -> 2026-03-22T09:35Z for nr-5521, 01:30Z -> 10:00Z for nr-5522. billing system shows owner=null and project=interactive-notebooks.

billing-bot: auto: detected new untagged consumption: 4523.76 USD; resources: nr-5521,nr-5522; recommended: temporary budget hold and alerting.

anika-ml: Those are likely from the self-service notebook reservation endpoint. We still allow anonymous launches via service account for some research buckets.

maria-finance: Two asks: 1) quick budget guard on the interactive-notebooks pool (daily cap 1,200 USD) while we triage, 2) 90-day backfill to attribute owners where possible and flag remaining unassigned.

jay-ops: I'll open INFRA-4237 to add the budget guard and a dry-run alert that emails finance. Also will dump kube events for the timeframe.

ben-security: If we add auto-injection of owner metadata, ensure audit events include original identity and injection actor. We need traceability for compliance.

anika-ml: For backfill, we can heuristically assign owners based on interactive session cookie and email mapping; will have an accuracy report. Might still leave ~5% unknown.

maria-finance: Fine. Schedule: budget guard and alert live within 24h (jay), backfill ETA 7 days (anika), policy for enforcement after review (maria + ben).

jay-ops: Budget guard created: https://infra.internal/budgets/interactive-notebooks -> cap 1200/day, hold action: alert-only for now. INFRA-4237 opened.

billing-bot: auto: budget guard applied (alert-only mode). Link: https://alerts.internal/alert/NotebookPoolBudget

anika-ml: Starting owner backfill job now. Will post results to the ticket with percent assigned + list of remaining resources.

maria-finance: Thanks. After backfill, finance will propose reallocation for the unidentified run costs and present options (charge to central R&D budget vs. pro-rate by active teams).

jay-ops: Noted. Pulling logs now. Follow-up in INFRA-4237.

maria-finance: Follow-up sync Thursday 10am PT.
